title: Accept RSA SSH keys
description: Mark 2026-10-22: RSA is not banned; docs say now is a good time to upgrade. Decisions: RSA 2048-16384 bits (floor = kernel maintainer-pgp-guide.rst:118), any odd e>=3 (matches OpenSSH), migrate pre-fills RSA auth subkeys >=2048 but prefers ed25519/P-256 when both exist. did:key = multicodec rsa-pub 0x1205 + DER RSAPublicKey. One spelling per key: reject non-minimal mpint/DER.
